description: Send one chat turn to a TurboMax text model and return its reply. SPENDS CREDITS (held, then settled to actual usage). Pass the user's question in message. The server keeps no history between calls, so to continue a thread with the same TurboMax model, pass your earlier turns with it in messages instead. Requires a "generate" key.

messages.description: Earlier turns exchanged with this TurboMax model through this tool, oldest first; the last message must be from the user.

modelId.description: Chat model id from list_chat_models. Omit for the default.

reasoningEffort.description: Only for models that support it.

name: chat
title: Chat with a model
